target: Build a runnable demonstration of continual rl protocols using a changing-environment RL schedule. Meet a declared latency and fail-safe limit under concurrent load.

competency.title: Implement continual rl protocols — real time
competency.outcome: Build a runnable demonstration of continual rl protocols using a changing-environment RL schedule. Meet a declared latency and fail-safe limit under concurrent load.

topic_kernel.measure: return, regret and retention over task order
topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: reusing a fixed task order as the holdout

competency.practice_task: Produce executable code or a runnable protocol grounded in a changing-environment RL schedule.
competency.setting_constraint: Meet a declared latency and fail-safe limit under concurrent load.
required_evidence: executable code or a runnable protocol
Include p95 latency, timeout behavior and rollback trace.
Report return, regret and retention over task order with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: reusing a fixed task order as the holdout.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of continual rl protocols.
Practice: the artifact passes a new functional case and a failure case.
Measurement: report return, regret and retention over task order against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for reusing a fixed task order as the holdout; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
